concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın genel eksiltme çekirdeğini ve bunun kişi payı, nesne değeri ile emek karşılığına uygulanabilmesini birlikte anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: bir payı, değeri veya karşılığı gereğinden aşağı düşürme

concept_map.definition: Bir hak, miktar veya değerde eksiklik bulunması ya da bunların olması gereken düzeyin altına indirilmesidir. Düşük fiyat, ölçüde eksik verme, yapılan işin ödülünün azaltılması, az miktardaki eksik bir şey ve karşılıklı zarara uğratma bu çekirdeğin ayrı görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Ortak çekirdek, bir hak, miktar veya değerde eksiklik bulunması ya da bunların olması gereken düzeyin altına indirilmesidir.
Bir kimsenin kendisine düşen payını eksiltmek, ona karşı yapılan bir haksızlık olarak değerlendirilir.
Bir şeye gerçek değerinin altında karşılık biçmek, eksiltme çekirdeğinin alışverişe bağlı görünümüdür.
Yapılan iş için verilecek ödülü azaltmak da aynı eksiltme ilişkisini korur.
Tarafların birbirini karşılıklı olarak eksiltmesi, her iki tarafın da ötekini zarara uğrattığı bir ilişki kurar.
Ölçü veya tartıda verilmesi gereken miktardan eksik vermek, niceliği azaltan özel bir gerçekleşmedir.
Az miktardaki eksik bir şey de eksiklik durumunu taşıyan bir kullanım olarak belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanım yay yapımında kullanılan bir ağaç veya odunu, ayrı bir kullanım ise insan bedenindeki atan ya da ince damarları adlandırır.

facets.statement: Yay yapmaya elverişli ağacı veya bu ağacın odununu adlandırır.
İnsan bedenindeki atan veya ince damarları adlandırır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağaç türünün veya odunun yay yapımındaki kullanımının kastedildiği botanik ve zanaat bağlamlarında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaç ile yay yapımı arasındaki amaç ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan bedenindeki atan ya da ince damarların çoğul olarak kastedildiği anatomi bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Beden içindeki damarları ve verilen iki niteliği korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yaylık ağaç ile beden damarları ayrı alt kullanımlardır; acı meyveli bitki ve çalılık yer anlamları bu dala girmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı söz biçimi çevresinde yay yapımında kullanılan bir ağacı ve insan bedenindeki atan ya da ince damarları birlikte verir. Bunlar tek bir nesne gibi tanımlanmamalı, iki ayrı gönderme olarak korunmalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yay yapımında kullanılan ağaç veya odun

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın biçimleri kapsar, ancak ağaç ve anatomi göndermeleri tanımda birbirinden açıkça ayrılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yaylık ağaç çekirdeğini doğrudan paylaşan komşu yayımlandı, damar ve odun adayları yalnız alan benzerliği taşıdı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Botanik gönderme örtüşse de odak dalın anatomi kullanımı komşuda yoktur; komşu dal ise yetişme yeri ve ok yapımı ayrıntılarını ekler.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ayrıca beden damarlarını adlandıran ayrı bir anatomi kullanımına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ağacı, dağ yamacındaki yetişme yeri ve ok yapımında kullanımıyla daha geniş biçimde niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yay yapımında kullanılan bir ağaç veya odun türünü belirtir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الشريان من شجر القسى (maqayis); الشريان شجر يتخذ منه القسى (sihah); الشريان واحد الشرايين وهي العروق النابضة (sihah); الشريان من الشجر الذي يتخذ منه القسي (tahdhib); الشريانات عروق رقاق في جسد الإنسان (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı, yay yapımında kullanılan ağaç veya odun anlamıyla insan bedenindeki atan ya da ince damar anlamını ayrı göndermeler olarak aktarır.

branches.what_is_ar: الشِّريان شجر يتخذ منه القسي، والشرايين عروق في جسد الإنسان
branches.what_is_not_ar: الشَّري الحنظل والشرى الموضع

concept_gloss.applicability: Şimşeğin bulut içinde dağıldığı ve parlamalarının sıkça birbirini izlediği hava olayları için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut içindeki yayılma ile art arda parlama bileşenlerini korur.

concept_map.definition: Şimşeğin bulutun yüzüne dağılarak yayılması, sık parlaması veya parlamalarının art arda sürmesidir.

facets.statement: Şimşeğin bulut içinde veya bulut yüzünde dağılıp yayılmasını bildirir.
Şimşeğin sık ve art arda parlamasını bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Şimşeğin bulut yüzünde farklı yönlere dağılarak görünmesi öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Şimşeğin bulut içindeki dağılıp yayılma yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Parlamaların sıklaşıp birbirini izlemesi öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sık ve ardışık parlama olayını doğal biçimde korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız şimşekle kurulan kullanımlardaki yayılma ve yinelenen parlama olayını kapsar; genel ışıldama anlamına genişletilmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şimşeğin bulut içinde yayılması, sık parlaması ve parlamalarının art arda gelmesi özelliklerini birlikte destekler. Geçici çerçeve bu olay örgüsünü doğru yansıtır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: şimşek buluta yayıldı veya art arda parladı

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal şimşekle kurulan ad birliklerine bağlıdır; buradan yalın biçim için genel parlama veya yayılma anlamı çıkarılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ardışık parlama koşulunu en keskin biçimde karşılaştıran komşu yayımlandı, diğerleri genel ışık veya zayıf parlama alanında kaldı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yayılma veya sık parlama yeterli olabilir; komşu dal ise parlamalar arasında ara kalmamasını zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, ardışıklığın yanında şimşeğin bulut yüzüne dağılıp yayılmasını ve parlamanın sıklaşmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, iki parlama arasında boşluk kalmayacak ölçüde kesintisiz ardışıklık koşulu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da şimşek parlamalarının sıklaşarak birbirini izlemesini anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: شرى البرق إذا استطار (maqayis); شري البرق في السحاب يشرى شرى إذا تفرق فيه (ayn); شرى البرق إذا كثر لمعانه (sihah); شري البرق إذا تفرق في وجه الغيم (tahdhib); شري البرق إذا تتابع لمعانه واستشرى مثله (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birleşik anlatımı, şimşeğin bulut içinde yayılması ile parlamalarının çoğalıp birbirini izlemesini aynı olay alanının bağlı yönleri olarak verir.

branches.what_is_ar: شري البرق إذا تفرق في السحاب أو كثر لمعانه وتتابع
branches.what_is_not_ar: البيع والنبات وداء الجلد

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın öfke, ısrar, hareket, akış ve durum artışı kullanımlarındaki ortak dinamik yapıyı özetlemek için uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Birini başka bir şeye karşı kışkırtan ettirgen kullanımı doğrudan ifade etmez.
error_profile.preserves: Taşkınlık, süreklilik, yinelenme ve büyüme ortaklığını korur.

concept_gloss.text: taşkın biçimde sürme, yinelenme veya büyüme

concept_map.definition: Bir duygu, davranış, hareket veya durumun taşkın biçimde hızlanması, inatla sürmesi, yinelenmesi ya da büyümesidir. Ayrı bir kullanım, birini bir şeye karşı kışkırtmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişinin öfkesinin taşkın biçimde yükselmesini bildirir.
Bir işte, yolda veya yanlış davranışta inatla sürmeyi ve geri durmamayı bildirir.
Hızlı ilerlemeyi veya dizgin gibi bir nesnenin sık ve ardışık hareketini bildirir.
Gözyaşının durmadan akması ya da insanlar arasındaki işlerin büyüyüp ağırlaşması gibi süreklilik ve artış durumlarını bildirir.
Birini bir kimseye veya şeye karşı kışkırtmayı bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin öfkesinin birden yükselip taşkın hale gelmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öfkenin taşkın ve denetimsiz biçimde yükselmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işte, yolda veya yanlış davranışta vazgeçmeden ilerleme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geri durmadan ısrarla devam etme anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanlar arasındaki sorun veya işlerin ağırlaşıp büyümesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Durumların zaman içinde büyüyüp ağırlaşmasını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her bağlamda aynı hareketi değil; öfke, ısrar, hız, yinelenme ve büyüme biçimindeki bağlantılı fakat ayrı gerçekleşmeleri kapsar.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi öfke, inatla sürdürme, hızlı ilerleme, dizginin çırpınması, gözyaşının yinelenmesi, işlerin büyümesi ve birini kışkırtma gibi ayrı kurulumları verir. Bunları tek bir eylem gibi birleştirmek yerine taşkınlık, süreklilik veya artış ortaklığı altında ayrı tutmak gerekir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir işte inatla diretti ve ileri gitti

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın karşılıklı inatlaşma adı ile kişi, yolculuk, dizgin, gözyaşı ve işler üzerinden kurulan kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; öfke ve taşkın yükseliş çekirdeğini en çok paylaşan komşu yayımlandı, diğerleri yalnız hareket, kışkırtma veya huzursuzluk alanında kesişti.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Öfke alanında yakınlaşırlar; odak dalın ayırıcı yönü inatçı süreklilik ve yinelenmedir, komşu dalınki ise sıçrayış ve şiddet artışıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal öfkenin yanı sıra ısrar, hız, yinelenen hareket, sürekli akış ve işlerin büyümesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, savaşın şiddeti, içkinin keskinliği ve sıçrayarak saldırma gibi yükselme görüntülerini de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da öfkenin veya bir durumun taşkın biçimde yükselmesini anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: شرى الرجل إذا استطير غضبا (maqayis); شرى البعير في سيره إذا أسرع (maqayis); استشرى الرجل إذا لج في الأمر (maqayis); شرى زمام الناقة إذا كثر اضطرابه (maqayis); شري فلان غضبا إذا استطار غضبا (sihah); استشرى أي لج في سننه (sihah); استشرى فلان في الغي إذا لج فيه (tahdhib); المشاراة الملاجة (tahdhib); شريت عينه بالدمع أي لجت وتابعت الهملان (tahdhib); استشرت أمور بينهم تفاقمت وعظمت (tahdhib); أشريته به فشري مثل أغريته به فغري (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı, öfkenin taşması, bir işte direnerek sürme, hızlanma, hareket veya akışın yinelenmesi, durumların büyümesi ve birinin kışkırtılması gibi ayrı gerçekleşmeleri aynı dalda toplar.

branches.what_is_not_ar: البرق إذا جعل فرعا مستقلا وداء الجلد والبيع

concept_gloss.applicability: Rahatsızlığın ayırt edici deri görünümünü ve yakıcılığını birlikte belirtmek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Küçüklük, kızarıklık, deri yerleşimi ve yakıcılık özelliklerini korur.

concept_map.definition: Deride küçük, kızarık, belirgin biçimli ve şiddetli yakıcılık veren kabarcıkların ortaya çıktığı bir rahatsızlıktır; bağlı kullanım derinin buna tutulmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Deride küçük, kızarık ve şiddetli yakıcılığı olan kabarcıklarla görülen rahatsızlığı adlandırır.
Derinin bu kabarcıklı ve yakıcı rahatsızlığa tutulmasını bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Derinin bu rahatsızlığa tutulmasını olay olarak anlatan cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Deride kabarcık oluşması ile yakıcılık özelliğini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel ağrı veya her tür deri çıkıntısı değildir; küçük, kızarık ve yakıcı deri kabarcıklarıyla belirlenen rahatsızlıktır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deride küçük, kırmızı, para biçimli ve şiddetli yakıcılığı olan kabarcıklar veya bir deri hastalığı anlamını destekler. Derinin bu hastalığa tutulmasını bildiren kullanım da aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yakıcı küçük kırmızı deri kabarcıklarıyla görülen hastalık

lexicalization_scope.note: Hastalık adı ile derinin bu hastalığa tutulmasını bildiren ad birliği ayrılır; ikisi aynı deri rahatsızlığına bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel deri çıkıntısı alanıyla özel yakıcı kabarcık sınırını en iyi gösteren komşu yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli görünüm ve yakıcılıkla sınırlıdır; komşu dal farklı neden ve türlerdeki deri çıkıntılarını genel olarak toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal küçük, kırmızı ve şiddetli yakıcılığı olan belirli deri kabarcıklarını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal irinli şişlik, çiçek hastalığı, yara ve darbe izi gibi çok çeşitli deri çıkıntılarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da deride belirginleşen kabarıklık veya çıkıntıları içeren rahatsızlıklarla ilgilidir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: شري جلده من الشرى وهي خراج صغار لها لذع شديد (sihah); الشري داء يأخذ في الرجل أحمر كهيئة الدراهم (tahdhib); شرى جلده شرى وهو شر (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, küçük ve yakıcı deri kabarcıklarıyla tanımlanan kırmızı bir rahatsızlığı ve derinin bu rahatsızlığa tutulmasını birlikte aktarır; kaynaklardan biri bu rahatsızlığı para biçimli görünümüyle ayrıca ayırır.

branches.what_is_ar: الشَّرى داء أو خراج صغار في الجلد لها لذع، ويقال شرى جلده أو شرى الرجل
branches.what_is_not_ar: الحنظل والبرق واللجاج

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca kanıtlanan havuz ve büyük yemek kabı nesneleriyle kurulan doldurma eylemi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Doldurma işlemi ile iki kanıtlanmış kap türünü korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir havuzu veya büyük yemek kabını doldurmak, özellikle misafirlere sunulacak yemek kaplarını dolu hale getirmektir.

facets.statement: Havuzu veya büyük yemek kabını içeriğiyle doldurmayı bildirir.
Misafirler için yemek kaplarını doldurmayı özel bir gerçekleşme olarak bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yemek kaplarının konuklara sunulmak üzere doldurulduğu ağırlama bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doldurma eylemini, kap türünü ve misafir amacını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kabın dolu sonucu veya içindekini sunma eylemi değil, havuz ya da yemek kabını doldurma işlemidir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir havuzu ya da büyük yemek kabını doldurma eylemini açıkça bildirir ve misafirler için yemek kaplarını doldurmayı özel bir durum olarak ekler. Geçici çerçeve kaynakla uyumludur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: havuzu veya büyük yemek kabını doldurmak

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal havuz ve yemek kabıyla kurulan kullanıma bağlıdır; buradan yalın biçim için genel doldurma anlamı çıkarılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı doldurma eylemini paylaşan komşu seçildi, diğerleri kap adı, doluluk sonucu veya taşma gibi farklı çekirdeklere sahipti.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Havuz bağlamında yakın anlamlıdırlar; odak dal kap türünü genişletirken komşu dal suyla yoğun doldurma koşulunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal havuzun yanında büyük yemek kaplarını ve bunların misafir için doldurulmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız havuzun suyla iyice ve sıkıca doldurulmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir havuzu suyla dolu hale getirme eylemini kapsar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أشريت الحوض وأشريت الجفنة إذا ملأتهما (sihah); أشرى حوضه ملأه وأشرى جفانه إذا ملأها للضيفان (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar havuz ile büyük yemek kabını doldurma çekirdeğinde birleşir; misafirler için yemek kaplarını doldurma bunun özel bağlamıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: أشرى الحوض والجفنة إذا ملأهما، وخاصة ملء الجفان للضيفان
branches.what_is_not_ar: البيع والهيجان والسقي نفسه

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli ayrılıkçı topluluğun kendi adlandırma gerekçesiyle birlikte açıklanması gereken kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk kimliği ile kendini Tanrı uğruna satma yorumunu korur.

concept_gloss.text: kendini Tanrı uğruna sattığını söyleyen topluluk

concept_map.definition: Kendilerini Tanrı uğruna sattıklarını söyleyen belirli bir ayrılıkçı topluluğa verilen addır; tekil biçim bir üyeyi, ilgili eylem de bu topluluğa katılmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Kendilerini Tanrı uğruna sattıkları yorumunu benimseyen belirli ayrılıkçı topluluğu adlandırır.
Tekil kullanım topluluğun bir üyesini, eylem kullanımı ise bu topluluğa katılmayı bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluk adının tekil biçimiyle o topluluğa bağlı bir kişinin kastedildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tek bir kişi ile tanımlı topluluk arasındaki üyelik bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin söz konusu topluluğa bağlanmasını bildiren eylem kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin belirli topluluğa katılma yönelimini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel satış değildir; kendini Tanrı uğruna sattığını ileri süren belirli topluluğun adı, üyesi ve o topluluğa katılma kullanımıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir ayrılıkçı topluluğun kendisini Tanrı uğruna sattığı yorumundan doğan topluluk adını destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki cennet seçeneği doğrudan kaynak ifadesinde yer almadığından tanım yalnız Tanrı uğruna kendini satma yorumuna bağlanmıştır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kendilerini Tanrı uğruna sattıklarını söyleyen ayrılıkçı topluluk

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın topluluk ve üye adlarını kapsar; genel bedelli satış anlamından türemiş özel bir topluluk adlandırması olarak sınırlandırılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kendini bedel sayma düşüncesini en açık paylaşan komşu yayımlandı, diğer adaylar ibadet, işaret veya kişi adı alanında daha uzaktı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mecazi bir öz adlandırma ve topluluk kimliğidir; komşu dal ise başka birini kurtarmaya yönelik gerçek bir yerine koyma işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kendini Tanrı uğruna satma yorumundan doğan belirli bir topluluk ve üye adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir kişiyi kurtarmak veya korumak için mal, can ya da kurbanı onun yerine verme işlemidir.

text.arabic_uthmani: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخْسٍۢ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍۢ وَكَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ

baseline.text: Onu düşük bir bedelle, birkaç dirheme sattılar; ona değer vermiyorlardı.

findings.text: Sayılı ve düşük bedel işlemi kapatsa da Yusuf'un değerini ölçemez; sayı burada değeri güvenceye almak yerine eksik değerlemeyi açığa çıkarır.

activation_trace.role: The literal buy-sell exchange supplies the transfer and makes valuation operative.
Sale consideration supplies the explicit value assigned in the exchange.
Diminution from a due right or measure turns the stated consideration into underpayment.
Enumeration bounds the payment as a small, surveyable quantity.

changed_reading.after: They liquidated a person through an explicitly miscalibrated exchange, substituting an easily counted sum for a value the sum fails to meet.
changed_reading.before: They disposed of him for a low stated price because they had little interest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of exchange, price, diminution, dirhams, and counting, closed by the sellers' detachment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse calibrates a transaction and then marks the calibration as defective: exchange is reduced to a readily enumerable cash amount that falls below the person's due measure.

activation_trace.role: Matching and counterpart imagery casts the sale as an attempted equivalence.
The price is the proposed monetary counterpart in that equation.
The deficit branch declares the proposed counterpart short of its due measure.
A thing counted against another sharpens the mechanism of failed commensuration.

changed_reading.after: The counted coins stage a failed equation: the verse displays the monetary counterpart and simultaneously labels it deficient.
changed_reading.before: The few coins are an incidental description of a cheap sale.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tight coupling of exchange, price, diminution, and a counted amount.
baseline_models.mechanism: The transaction proposes an equivalence between Yusuf and the coins, while the diminution term invalidates that equivalence from inside the pricing phrase. Counting does not merely report smallness; it exposes the attempted equation.

activation_trace.role: Standing for or taking charge of someone supplies the stewardship relation that their detachment vacates.
Exchange provides the concrete means by which responsibility is transferred away.
The diminished amount marks how little responsibility the transferors retain in their valuation.

changed_reading.after: Their lack of desire is a withdrawal from stewardship, with the cheap exchange functioning as a rapid transfer of both custody and concern.
changed_reading.before: Their lack of desire merely explains why they accepted little money.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exchange and the construction that they were, regarding him, among the detached.
baseline_models.mechanism: A care-bearing branch of being makes the sellers' detachment relational rather than merely emotional: the low-price transfer records withdrawal from keeping or standing for him.

activation_trace.role: The focus exchange is the liquidation event whose motive the prior sequence revises.
The deficient valuation is recast as the cost of quick disposal.
The well-bucket extraction supplies an accidental acquisition rather than cultivated stock.
Concealment supplies secrecy and makes prolonged possession costly or risky.
A piece of capital made into merchandise supplies the conversion of person into liquidable inventory.

changed_reading.after: They priced a secretly acquired windfall for quick conversion into cash, so the deficit reflects their disposal conditions as much as their judgment of him.
changed_reading.before: The sellers simply judged him to have little market value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence moves from extraction out of a well to concealment and commercial inventory. That makes the deficient price less like a calm appraisal and more like fast monetization of an unplanned, hidden acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accidental extraction, concealment, and merchandising; the reader supplies the arrow that secrecy creates pressure for rapid cheap liquidation. A live alternative is that the small price reflects ordinary bargaining rather than concealment risk.
structural_cues: 12:19 immediately orders discovery, concealment as merchandise, and divine knowledge before the sale in 12:20.
The same object pronoun carries the found boy through concealment and exchange.

activation_trace.role: The stewardship branch supplies the care relation that changes hands across the sale.
The repeated exchange root identifies the purchaser's response as the immediate other side of the focus transaction.
Honor and generosity reverse the sellers' diminished treatment.
Lodging and guest-space turn the purchased object into someone to be housed.
Expected benefit supplies a countervaluation that already exceeds indifference.
Taking or acquiring supplies the deliberate shift from purchase toward a durable relation.
The child relation supplies the strongest possible reversal from anonymous merchandise to kin-like standing.
Empowerment and establishment detach Yusuf's eventual standing from the sellers' price.

changed_reading.after: The cheap sale is a relational hinge: detached sellers relinquish Yusuf into a household that can imagine honor and filiation, while his later standing proves independent of their price.
changed_reading.before: The cheap sale terminates the sellers' brief possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next buyer imagines honorable lodging, benefit, and filiation, while the narrative names Yusuf's establishment. The sale therefore becomes a hinge between incompatible regimes of relation: disposable hidden stock on one side, a person worth housing, adopting, and establishing on the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purchase followed by honor, possible benefit or adoption, and establishment; the reader supplies the arrow that the sale transfers Yusuf between valuation and stewardship regimes. A live alternative is that the buyer's care remains appropriative or utility-driven rather than purely honoring.
structural_cues: 12:21 repeats the exchange root and immediately changes the speech register from price to lodging, benefit, and child relation.
The narrator's establishment clause exceeds both sellers' and buyer's stated intentions.

activation_trace.role: Monetary consideration supplies the narrow measure challenged by the later endowment.
Counting one thing against another frames the focus as an attempted commensuration.
Sound judgment and wisdom supply a nonmonetary capacity omitted by the sellers' measure.
Disclosure to a knower supplies an epistemic value invisible in the cash exchange.
Recompense that answers an act supplies a rival economy of fitting return.
Excellent action supplies the quality to which the later recompense is proportioned.

changed_reading.after: The sale uses the wrong kind of measure: countable consideration is set against capacities and fitting recompense that cannot be reduced to a market counterpart.
changed_reading.before: The sale assigns Yusuf too little monetary value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verse measures Yusuf by deficient cash; 12:22 measures his maturation within judgment, disclosed knowledge, and recompense for excellence. The second measure does not furnish a higher market quote but exposes the first measure's category error.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a counted price and then judgment, knowledge, excellence, and recompense; the reader supplies the contrast as a countervaluation that reveals category error. A live alternative is that divine endowment and market price are sequential but not intended as competing measures.
structural_cues: 12:22 follows the low-price transfer with maturation and a gift-recompense construction.
The later measure concerns capacities and conduct rather than possession or cash.

activation_trace.role: A state occurring in time makes the sellers' detachment available for later reversal.
Active solicitation supplies the first direct opposite of seller indifference.
An intention forming within the self intensifies the reversal from detachment to inward engagement.
Love reaching the heart's covering supplies an image of desire penetrating to the center.
Love adhering to the heart makes the later valuation sustained rather than momentary.

changed_reading.after: Their detachment reports only their own situated relation to him; the ensuing excess of desire exposes it as contingent, strategic, and sharply reversible.
changed_reading.before: Their detachment reports that Yusuf was generally unwanted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sellers' detachment is followed by solicitation, inwardly formed intention, and love reaching and adhering to the heart. This sharp reversal makes their detachment a local relation and strategy, not a stable description of Yusuf's desirability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seller detachment followed by solicitation and heart-penetrating love; the reader supplies the retrospective arrow that later desire localizes and destabilizes the sellers' valuation. A live alternative is that morally disordered desire is no reliable evidence of worth.
structural_cues: The focus closes with seller detachment; 12:23-24 and 12:30 repeatedly intensify desire toward the same person.
The reversal crosses economic, bodily, and affective domains without changing the focus referent.

activation_trace.role: Finite enumeration supplies the focus scene's confidence that Yusuf can be measured.
Counterpart imagery makes the coins an attempted equivalent whose adequacy can later collapse.
One-by-one numerical distribution echoes the focus's controlled enumeration before perception breaks control.
Magnification within the observers supplies the immediate expansion beyond the earlier small measure.
Angelic comparison supplies the explicit displacement of ordinary human classification.
Nobility and honor reverse the focus's diminished monetary counterpart.

changed_reading.after: The coins become an ironic attempt to keep Yusuf measurable; later perception drives observers beyond ordinary classification, exposing the earlier equivalence as narratively untenable.
changed_reading.before: A few countable coins are simply an inadequate price.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 12:31 each observer is individually equipped, yet their sight of Yusuf produces magnification and a negation of ordinary human classification in favor of noble angelic comparison. The counted cash in the focus becomes a foil for a person whom observers cannot keep within an ordinary category.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies controlled one-by-one distribution followed by magnification and category displacement; the reader supplies the arrow that this scene retrospectively collapses the focus's monetary commensuration. A live alternative is that the speech is shock-hyperbole and does not establish an objective counterprice.
structural_cues: 12:31 first distributes one knife to each woman, then records a collective failure of bodily and categorical control on seeing Yusuf.
The utterance negates ordinary human classification before supplying an elevated comparison.

activation_trace.role: The literal sale supplies the initial transfer of control that later claims reenact.
Solicitation supplies an attempted acquisition of Yusuf's compliance.
The split sale-return branch lets the renewed solicitation function as an exploratory counter-transaction.
Protective self-holding supplies resistance to being disposed of by another's demand.
Binding demand converts solicitation into an asserted right to command.
Confinement supplies the threatened enforcement mechanism when compliance cannot be acquired.
Humiliation supplies the status penalty attached to refusing the imposed disposition.

changed_reading.after: The sale opens a continuing struggle over who can classify, command, and dispose of Yusuf; later coercion attempts to purchase compliance with avoidance of prison and humiliation.
changed_reading.before: The focus sale is a completed transfer of ownership for too little money.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sale transfers control once, but later solicitation, self-protective holding, command, prison, and threatened humiliation repeatedly contest who may dispose of Yusuf. Under the split mapping of solicitation into a sale-return branch, the later demand can be carried as a coercive counter-transaction rather than merged with the affection reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sale, renewed solicitation, resistance, command, and confinement; the reader supplies the arrow that these are successive contests over disposition and treats the split sale-return branch as a counter-transaction. A live alternative is that the later coercion is only a new episode enabled by household power, not a structural replay of the sale.
structural_cues: 12:32 joins solicitation, refusal, command, imprisonment, and abasement in one conditional threat.
The sequence distinguishes Yusuf's self-disposition from household power over his body and status.

remaining_uncertainties: The exchange root itself permits buy-sell directionality; the local sequence resolves roles narratively but the branch does not encode direction.
The buyer's honor and adoption language may represent care, appropriation, utility, or a mixture of all three.
Later desire and astonishment destabilize the sellers' valuation but are not automatically reliable measures of intrinsic worth.
The ecological, preparation, and eye-hand models are auditable branch activations, not grammatical replacements for the focus words' ordinary senses.
strongest_changes: The preceding concealment-as-merchandise sequence revises the low price into secrecy-driven liquidation of an accidental acquisition.
The purchaser's honor, lodging, possible filiation, and Yusuf's establishment separate transaction price from relational standing and future capacity.
Later wisdom, fitting recompense, intense desire, and category-breaking astonishment turn the counted price into a failed kind of measure rather than merely a small amount.
The sale remains readable both as transfer into care and as the opening of repeated coercive contests over Yusuf's disposition.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports coexisting economic, relational, epistemic, and bodily readings. Especially live were the failed-equivalence mechanism, the reversal from detachment to desire, the split mapping from later preparation back into the focus counting inventory, and the contained ecological and eye-hand outliers.

activation_trace.role: Yield without deliberate watering supplies the image of value obtained without investment.
The literal well extraction gives the ecological branch a visible water-and-retrieval trigger.
Merchandise capital converts the retrieved windfall into an immediately saleable yield.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sale monetizes an uncultivated windfall: the traders invest no formation or care, retrieve value unexpectedly, and therefore accept a low return.
changed_reading.before: The deficient adjective only says that the price was reduced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's branch for unirrigated land or crop rather than its ordinary deficit sense. It remains anchored in the focus adjective and is contextually triggered by well extraction followed by merchandising. Render it only as an ecological-commercial analogy: the packet does not say Yusuf is produce or that this branch controls the syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjective on the price, activated through its no-irrigation land and crop branch.

activation_trace.role: Preparing a reserve makes the counted coins available as a hand-ready means of closing the transaction.
The split mapping reactivates the same readiness branch in a deliberately prepared viewing scene.
The primary prepared-and-present branch grounds the later scene in actual staging rather than sound resemblance alone.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the coins are also a ready instrument that stages a rapid transfer, later echoed by another actor's prepared objects staging a coercive revelation.
changed_reading.before: Counted only limits the number of coins.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the focus counting root through its preparation branch and then uses the packet's split mapping of a later preparation root back into the same mapped inventory. It remains formally auditable at both occurrences and produces a staging mechanism. Render it as branch resonance, not as a claim that the focus adjective grammatically means prepared.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The counted dirhams, through the focus root's branch of making provisions ready.

activation_trace.role: The damaged-eye branch supplies a contained image of valuation that fails to see.
The finger branch joins the deficit term to the bodily means by which coins can be counted.
Enumeration supplies the controlled manual measure that the later scene disrupts.
Actual sight supplies the perceptual trigger absent from the sellers' deficient measure.
Severing supplies the loss of bodily control that interrupts calm measurement.
The literal hands complete the eye-to-hand reversal of the earlier counting scene.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the low price is an eye-hand failure of valuation: later direct sight so overwhelms manual control that the very hands associated with measure are cut.
changed_reading.before: The sellers' hands calmly count a deficient monetary measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus deficit root's eye and finger branches together, then links them to explicit seeing and cut hands. It remains anchored in two supplied focus branches and a concrete later eye-hand event, but the link from counted coins to manual counting is reader-supplied. Render it as an imagistic reversal of valuation, never as the lexical sense of the focus adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The deficient price and counted dirhams, through the focus root's eye and finger branches.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Counting contracts value rather than securing it.** ع د د B001 (enumerating), paired with the few coins, is governed by ز ه د B001/B002 (scant amount; turning away in desire while accepting little). I infer that enumeration gives transactional closure to a radically deficient valuation. The ayah reads as a critique of calculability: what can be counted is not thereby adequately valued.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:54-55 reversed the scant counted price into trusted control of storehouses; the person undercounted in sale became guardian of national measure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Exchange with no stable viewpoint.** `ش ر ي:B001` is “exchange through selling and buying,” and its accepted scope explicitly allows reciprocal buying/selling uses; `ش ر ي:B002` adds equivalence and matching. The fixed ayah stresses a deficient price, while 12:21 immediately names the purchaser who sees possible benefit or sonship. The packet gives one body, two sides of exchange, and radically different valuations; I infer that price fails to measure the exchanged person. The ayah reads as a perspectival transaction whose low numerical equivalence exposes rather than establishes value.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:59 makes full measure a credential and 12:65 makes returned goods reopen exchange, so this low-price sale is retrospectively exposed as one distorted valuation inside a larger economy of measured provision and relational return.

words.gloss_range: opening connector that resumes the human action-line while also binding the sale to the prior discovery and concealment sequence
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the sale from starting as an isolated report. It resumes the human sequence after the divine knowledge frame in 12:19 while still coordinating the sale with discovery and concealment. Because the particle is fused to the completed sale verb, the ayah moves abruptly into a compressed transaction report: the person found and hidden is now carried into sale grammar.

topics.headline: narrative bridge after the prior scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah resumes the human action-line across the divine comment in 12:19 instead of beginning a detached sale notice.
topics.reason: The connector is compatible with coordination and resumption, and the prior ayah supplies the interrupted action-line it resumes.

topics.headline: compressed launch into transaction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the boundary shift from discovery and divine knowledge into a brisk completed sale report.
topics.reason: The particle is proclitic on the perfect verb, so relation and completed action enter as one surface launch.

words.gloss_range: completed sale or exchange act with Joseph carried as attached object; local frame selects seller-side disposal, while the root family keeps both poles of exchange nearby
words.prose: {{ar:شَرَوْهُ}} ({{tr:sharawhu}}) presents the transaction as already completed before the price details arrive. Its attached object keeps Joseph grammatically present but unnamed, while the plural subject remains unresolved. The local frame joins object and compensation in one exchange event, and the Form I surface is seller-facing disposal rather than the buyer-centered acquisition that follows in 12:21. The wider exchange field makes the sale morally charged: low-price exchange formulas such as 2:16, 2:102, and 3:77 stand behind the literal sale, while 12:77 lets the commercial sound-world return in accusation and moral status language.
words.root_gloss_range: exchange root covering sale and purchase directions in different forms and frames; here the attached object plus price phrase select seller-side transfer for compensation

topics.headline: completed commercial action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens its content with a sealed transaction, not with deliberation or description.
topics.reason: The QAC row and verb instance identify a perfect 3mp exchange verb at the start of the sale clause.

topics.headline: attached object with unresolved sellers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Joseph carried through a suffix as the object of others' action while the selling group is grammatically plural but not overtly named.
topics.reason: The object suffix is strongly linked to the boy from 12:19, but the 3mp subject is explicitly marked ambiguous, so rows naming a specific seller group must be kept as unresolved sellers.

topics.headline: seller-side exchange with cheap-disposal pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb binds Joseph and the price into one exchange frame, with the following deficient price coloring the sale as liquidation below worth.
topics.reason: The root can span sale and purchase directions, but the attached object and governed price phrase select the local seller-side transfer.

topics.headline: seller disposal answered by buyer acquisition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a hinge between 12:20 and 12:21: disposal by one group is immediately answered by acquisition by the Egyptian buyer.
topics.reason: The local Form I verb contrasts with the next ayah's related acquisition form, preserving a perspective shift across adjacent ayahs.

topics.headline: literal sale inside a wider bad-exchange field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears Joseph's literal sale against Quranic bad-exchange patterns without replacing the local narrative sale with those formulas.
topics.reason: The cited parallels support moral exchange pressure, but they remain echoes and contrasts; the local verb still reports a concrete sale in 12:20.

words.gloss_range: exchange-price preposition marking the compensation received for the sale, not instrument, location, or accompaniment
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns the following noun phrase into the sale consideration. In this frame it is not an instrument marker; it welds the deficient price to the transaction itself. By attaching directly to the price noun, the preposition pivots the ayah from the act of sale into the descending valuation chain, with even the cadence of the governed phrase helping it read as one unit.

topics.headline: price marker for compensation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following phrase is the exchange price, not a loose instrument or detached aside.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the governed price phrase syntactically forced as the sale consideration.

topics.headline: hinge from sale into valuation cascade
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the preposition as the hinge that converts the completed sale into a measured and deficient valuation.
topics.reason: The proclitic form binds relation to the price noun, and the following phrase develops the valuation cascade.

words.gloss_range: an unspecified exchange price that is immediately lowered by deficiency and then specified as counted coins
words.prose: {{ar:ثَمَنٍ}} ({{tr:thamanin}}) first names the transaction in the broad category of price or assigned value. Its indefiniteness leaves the value unspecified just long enough for the next modifier to damage it, then the phrase narrows from abstract price to concrete counted currency. The word also sits in a wider low-price formula field, so references such as 5:44 and 3:187 heighten the moral pressure, while the local wording specializes that pressure as Joseph's literal sale.
words.root_gloss_range: price, value, and appointed equivalence, with a related counting/eightness field; locally the exchange-value branch is selected and then undermined

topics.headline: unspecified price before demotion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged reveal: the sale is first given a price, then that price is immediately exposed as deficient.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the exchange preposition and modified by the following deficient descriptor, so value and demotion are bound inside one phrase.

topics.headline: price descends into counted coins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the price move downward step by step from value category to deficient quality to concrete countable payment.
topics.reason: The local noun phrase stacks price, deficiency, currency, and countedness, so the valuation is progressively particularized and lowered.

words.gloss_range: deficient or wrongful shortfall qualifying the price itself; low value with moral-commercial injustice, not mere cheapness
words.prose: {{ar:بَخْسٍ}} ({{tr:bakhsin}}) is locked to the price by agreement, so the shortfall belongs to the valuation itself. Because the word is an abstract noun functioning as a modifier, it classifies the price under wrongful deficiency rather than merely saying the coins were few. The rare root's defrauding field, including prohibitions and legal-commercial echoes at 7:85, 11:15, and 2:282, makes the low price a moral indictment embedded in the noun phrase, and the rough kh sound makes the deficient-price phrase audibly rougher at the word of shortfall.
words.root_gloss_range: diminishing, defrauding, withholding due measure, and wrongful shortfall; locally the noun classifies the price as deficient

words.gloss_range: named coinage specifying the deficient price as concrete countable currency; a rare currency term made small by the following counted modifier
words.prose: {{ar:دَرَاهِمَ}} ({{tr:darāhima}}) turns abstract deficient value into named money. Its syntactic role specifies what the price consisted of, and its plural coin-shape prepares the final counted modifier, making the sum feel small piece by piece. The word is also striking because it is the only named coin term in the Quranic corpus according to the supplied evidence, so Joseph's misvaluation becomes uniquely concrete here. That low monetary frame is immediately answered by the honor command in 12:21.

words.gloss_range: passive counted/few modifier of the dirhams, presenting the payment as bounded, already counted, and small
words.prose: {{ar:مَعْدُودَةٍ}} ({{tr:maʿdūdatin}}) seals the price phrase by making the coins counted, bounded, and therefore unimpressive. The passive participle foregrounds the counted result while suppressing the counter, and its agreement confines the smallness to the coin payment. Because the next clause begins with the sellers' being, the ayah turns from counted objects to classified people. Counted-few patterns such as 3:24 and 11:8 support the smallness pressure, but here the counted thing is Joseph's price.
words.root_gloss_range: counting, reckoning, numbering, and treating as a counted set; locally the passive participle marks the coins as a bounded small sum

words.gloss_range: second connector introducing the final state clause, with coordination, circumstance, and explanation all live
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from counted payment to the sellers' state. It can coordinate the final clause with the sale, make the indifference concurrent with it, and let that indifference explain the low price. Repeating the same small connector at both clause launches frames the ayah as two movements: commercial act, then moral disposition.

topics.reason: The coordinated state clause is strongly licensed, and the connector can carry circumstantial and explanatory pressure.

words.gloss_range: plural past copula introducing a predicate complex that classifies the unnamed sellers with respect to Joseph or the matter
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا}} ({{tr:kānū}}) changes the ayah's mode from what the sellers did to what state or class they occupied. Its predicate is the whole concern-and-class phrase that follows, so the sale is reframed as evidence of disposition. The verb also leaves two uncertainties alive: the sellers are plural but unnamed, and the state can be read as concurrent with the sale or already established. Surah 12 echoes sharpen the verdict grammar, especially the contrast between the planned becoming of 12:9 and the actual classification here, and later status language at 12:77 and 12:85.
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, and standing in a state or status; locally a copular classification verb, not an action verb

words.gloss_range: fronted concern phrase with attached masculine pronoun, marking the sphere of indifference as him, the matter, or both
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) supplies the domain of the final verdict before the class label appears. In this predicate it is not a loose spatial phrase but the sphere in which indifference operates. The suffix keeps Joseph or the transaction present without naming him, and that ambiguity is productive: the sellers are indifferent toward him personally and/or toward the commercial matter. The same pronoun chain carries the discovered and concealed figure from 12:19 into both the sale object and the concern-domain, contrasting divine knowledge in 12:19 with human failure to value in 12:20.

words.gloss_range: partitive or classificatory particle placing the sellers among a definite plural class, not marking physical source
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the step from concern-domain to class label. With the definite plural that follows, it does not mean physical source; it makes the sellers members of a recognized category. The short particle and final class word function as one predicate package after the copula, and the construction joins Surah 12's verdict grammar, including class-assignment shapes such as 12:29 and 12:85.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active participle naming those characterized by disinterest or lack of desire with respect to Joseph or the matter; locally negative commercial indifference, not spiritual virtue
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ}} ({{tr:al-zāhidīn}}) is the ayah's final landing. The active participle and definite plural make the sellers bearers of a class-disposition, while the concern phrase keeps the disinterest aimed at Joseph or the transaction. Its root can suggest renunciation, but the local sale context turns that into a negative irony: they let Joseph go as not worth retaining. The word's hapax weight, definite class grammar, assimilated z sound, and closure position converge so that the ayah ends not on coins but on character. The next ayah reverses the valuation through honor in 12:21, while class-verdict shapes such as 12:29 and 12:85 keep the phrase inside Surah 12's moral classification grammar.
words.root_gloss_range: lack of desire, disinterest, considering something beneath retention, and later renunciant associations; locally the concern construction selects cold undervaluing
